name: my_app_server
description: Start a project dev server in background with custom log/pid paths.
help:
Start ~/Projects/my-app/start_server.sh in background.

log_path and pid_path are optional. Without them cy uses logs/<name>.log and run/<name>.pid.

Aliases:
mas

Controls:
cy my_app_server --status
cy my_app_server --stop
cy my_app_server --restart

Examples:
cy mas
cy mas -p 3000
cy mas --stop
